texte.Aucune présomption de conformité n'en so: No presumption of conformity comes out of it, and no date will change that: this guidance implements two recommendations, it is not a harmonised standard.
texte.Causer oblige à faire cesser ET à répare: Causing requires both ceasing the impact AND remedying the harm. Contributing requires ceasing one's contribution, remedying one's share, and building leverage over the business relationship. Being linked requires using that leverage, and building it where it is missing. That is box # of the document, and that is where the cap comes from: no part can be claimed beyond the step that your involvement makes non-negotiable.
texte.Ce que ce module refuse de dire: What this module refuses to say
texte.Ce qui est de l’OCDE, et ce qui: What is the OECD's, and what
texte.Ce taux ne s'appelle pas conformité, et: This rate is not called conformity, and the word appears nowhere: the document itself declares its examples non-exhaustive.
texte.C’est la question qui commande le NIVEAU: It is the question that commands the LEVEL of
texte.Descendez les six étapes. Seuls les exem: Work down the six steps. Only the examples that one of your groups is targeted by enter the calculation; the others leave it instead of counting zero.
texte.Descendez les étapes dans l’ordre : chac: Work down the steps in order: each carries its sub-step, what it asks and the trap that lies there. The batch button answers for a whole step when the answer is the same throughout. Four answers: held, partially held, absent, not applicable.
texte.Diligence OCDE — je veux savoir si mon e: OECD due diligence — I want to know whether my company did what it had to, not only whether my system is compliant
texte.Diligence OCDE — la source, sa licence e: OECD due diligence — the source, its licence and its limits
texte.Diligence OCDE — les six feuilles de rou: OECD due diligence — the six roadmaps
texte.Diligence OCDE — les six étapes et leurs: OECD due diligence — the six steps and their examples
texte.Déclarez AUTANT DE GROUPES que nécessair: Declare AS MANY GROUPS as needed: the document expressly writes that they are neither rigid nor exclusive, and a publisher that trains on its own data and operates for its clients is in two. Then choose your involvement — cause, contribute, be linked — and rate your risks on the four factors, each with its written justification.
texte.Déclarez d’abord un groupe. Tant qu’aucu: Declare a group first. As long as none
texte.Déclarez vos groupes — ils ne sont ni ri: Declare your groups — they are neither rigid nor exclusive —, your involvement in the impact, and rate your risks on the four factors with their justification.
texte.Elle ne fige pas votre implication : le: It does not fix your involvement: the document writes that a direct link becomes a CONTRIBUTION if the company carries on doing nothing. And it does not mistake a rating for a prioritisation: the document asks for a CREDIBLE process whose reasoning is made public, so a rating with no written justification caps the “identify” part at one half.
texte.Elle ne rend pas un taux de conformité,: It does not return a conformity rate, and the word does not appear in it. The document itself declares that its examples do not constitute an exhaustive checklist: what is measured here is called COVERAGE OF THE EXAMPLES RETAINED. An organisation can hold them all and still be in breach of due diligence on a risk none of them names.
texte.L'implication fixe le niveau de diligenc: Involvement sets the level of due diligence expected: causing requires both ceasing and remedying, contributing requires ceasing one's share and building one's leverage, being linked requires using that leverage. It is involvement that caps the rate, and it is box # of the document that says so.
texte.La gravité se lit sur l’échelle, la port: Severity is read on scale, scope and irremediability;
texte.La licence CC BY de l’OCDE ne couvre pas: The OECD's CC BY licence does not cover third-party material present in its work. The ISO, IEEE and AI Verify clauses cited in these tables are therefore given by NUMBER AND TITLE only, as an index — the same doctrine as this repository's ISO modules.
texte.La licence CC BY permettrait de les trad: The CC BY licence would allow them to be translated. They are not, for the reason that already holds for the # actions of the NIST generative AI profile: it is the wording an auditor will look for. A translation would in addition require carrying the adaptation notice on each of the # rows. The French around them is the firm's.
texte.Le document écrit que ce n'est PAS un ca: The document writes that this is NOT an equivalency framework — and of those twenty frameworks, Sentinel measures three. The other seventeen are named here and not held.
texte.Le logo, l’identité visuelle et l’image: The OECD's logo, visual identity and cover image, and any suggestion that the OECD endorses this use. Concrete consequence: this module's colour in the sidebar is not the OECD blue, and no mark is reproduced.
texte.Le poids suit la charge, pas le nombre d: The weight follows the burden, not the number of examples: step # carries twenty-four of them for group # alone and step # carries only two — yet it is step # that is the strongest expectation as soon as the company causes or contributes.
texte.Les ponts viennent du DOCUMENT, pas du c: The bridges come from the DOCUMENT, not from the firm: it is the OECD that sets its six steps alongside the AI Act, ISO/IEC #, the NIST framework and seventeen other frameworks.
